question: Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank no. 4.
solution:
The correct answer is: **for.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The word **"for"** denotes the purpose of something or in favor of.

 
 
• **Example:** Technologies are essential for holistic rural development.
